reviews.text: My 1st time visit since moving to Richardson & was happy to say Dr. Cortiaus addressed my Shih Tzu’s ear issues & advised the plan we should take to decide on the correct medication for her. He spent time explaining which was much appreciated. The front office to the back was filled with nice & helpful employees . I will be returning & do recommend them!

Our 6 1/2 year old pup had his teeth cleaned under anesthesia. Everything went well. We are very happy with the doctors and staff at this clinic. It’s very obvious that they truly care for the animals they see. They are great at answering questions and explaining whatever is needed for our pup’s best health.
The entire staff is friendly and professional. It’s good to know the clinic carries on with the excellent care Dr. Krug provided our pets for many years before his retirement.
We trust Campbell with all of our babies.

We've had four dogs with Campbell Village. They are true animal lovers. The staff member takes time and care with each patient, as if they were the only one in the office. I trust that my furr babies are in good hands.
I cannot rate this place highly enough! The staff is wonderful, they take excellent care of my dog, and they always follow up to make sure we received the best care possible. So happy I found them!!

The staff is always happy to see Mishka, and always friendly and helpful.  When I had to put down my other elderly dog, Dr. Cortiaus was kind, unhurried, and empathetic. He even allowed my child to ask questions, time to cry, and give a good bye hugs to our dog.

This is the best veterinary clinic I have ever visited. The staff is friendly, welcoming, and genuinely cares about our pets. From the moment you walk in, you feel right at home.
Dr. Siegfried Coady, DVM, is wonderful. He takes the time to explain everything clearly and makes sure all of your questions are answered. You leave feeling informed, confident, and happy with the care your pet receives.
Took the best care of my best buddy for a long time before sending him over the rainbow bridge comfortably and with dignity. 💜 Love you guys. Thank you for taking care of Casper. …

I am so disgusted by what I recieve as a selfish policy on the part of the doctor at this practice. He insists on doing lab work on our 16yo dog before agreeing to euthanize the dog. That means we have to take our frail dog up to the clinic for a lab draw, bring him home, and then take him back if the doctor agrees. This is cruel to us and our pet. There is no state or federal requirement for this additional lab work. There comes a time for all family members, pets included, to stop trying to prolong life and allow life to end with dignity. The doctor, who won't miss our family member in the days to come, wants to be sure he feels good about the decision. That is prioritizing his feelings, not us or our pet's best interest.

I'll also note that when we started this difficult conversation, we were sent an email telling us the doctor doesn't do convenience euthanizing. Telling us that is the same as heartlessly telling us that we are making a difficult decision out of convienence. But, again, the doctor says that to make himself feel better.

Now we have to try to find another provider willing to do the right thing: Acknowledge that our dog is 16, frail, and worthy of a thoughtful, dignified end of life without unnecessary pokes, prods, and stress.
Have been a happy dog parent using Campbell Veterinary Clinic for 20 years / great staff and vet techs and always informative and compassionate doctors.

Probably the best that I have ever dealt with with Over several years, and eight rescue pups
The environment is like family they make you feel welcome, and they go out of their way to be nice to people and pets. Dr. William is the vet that I work with, he is great to stop and explain everything that’s happening and then follow up with detailed emails.
And the pricing is always very reasonable. I would give them 10 stars if I could!  I highly recommend
Thank you for your review!
Dr. Coady is the best!
Came in for a few lab tests and a check up. Was in and out quickly.

Dr Cortiaus is an absolutely wonderful Dr. He really cares about his patients and it shows. My dog Atlas had to have emergency surgery and you can tell how meticulous and focused he is when having your pets life on the line. He truly cares about the pets and clients. I have been bringing my babies to him for close to 20 years now and would not want anyone else to care for my baby. What makes it even better is that the whole staff is amazing kind and compassionate you can tell everyone up there truly loves what they do. From the moment you walk through the door and are granted with warm smiles and conversations that help so much in tense situations to the very techs and assistance that are passionate helpful and so friendly. I am grateful to them all.

I have been coming to this clinic for 30 years. The original vet was Dr. Harold Krug who was beyond amazing! Dr. Krug has since retired but before doing so, he mentored Dr. Cordiaus, who in turn brought on Dr. Coady! I was a little resistant to the "change", but.... They kept their team intact and continue to be an amazing group! Anthony, Jenny, Theresa, Ericka, the OG's are still there, and both Doctors are incredibly kind! They ALL love our fur babies as if they were their own, I am a LIFER for sure!
What kind people! Cannot say enough good things about them and their remarkable care of our beloved pets - whatever their stage of life. 💥💕 …

I got a puppy in mid-December and have brought him here for both of his appointments so far. The staff are extremely welcoming and friendly, and my puppy loves to say hi to all of them. The Dr. is very knowledgeable and I feel he truly had my dog’s best interest in mind. Prices seem reasonable and  I LOVED that the first exam for him was free. I will continue to come here for as long as I have pets!
Would never take my dogs any place but here.  I trust them implicitly. Excellent practice, kind and professional.
All I can say awesome !!!!!!!!

We just moved to Dallas a few weeks ago and our dog, Ubu, got sick on the weekend. Following up on a late night visit to emergency vet, I called Campbell Village Vet Clinic to get an appointment. They scheduled me later that morning. Dr. Bill was great - took a thorough history and explained everything. Got some blood work, urine and poop. They called me the next day to check on Ubu and called with test results (fortunately normal) the following day. Very nice folks and great follow-up.
They are wonderful loving people. I couldn’t think of going anywhere else.

I recently moved and it required me to find a new vet for my pitbull. So thankful that I landed at this clinic. The care and treatment is the most attentive that I could have hoped for. I have never had a vet Email me a findings report. Very clinical but the staff was warm and friendly and joked with each other. I have recommended them to several people already.

The staff here really care.  We were pleased they were able to fit us in on short notice.  And they followed up with a call to let us know both of our "babies" are healthy, no worries!   I also like they have separate dog and cat sides.

Doctors Corteaus and Dr Caody and ALL their staff are so caring for our 3 dogs!  They are knowledgeable from puppy stage to geriatric.  When I leave the offices, I know my pups have been in great hands whether we were there for a problem or for a well visit!  Thank you💕

The crew at at Campbell Village Vet Hospital are the best in every way. Great with everyone that comes in, professionals, courteous, caring, and willing to help in any situation. Dr. Cortius, and Dr. Cody are excellent vets.
I would not trust my pets with anyone else and highly recommend this clinic.,
Hands down the best veterinary clinic I have experienced in North Texas since I’ve been here since 1991

The staff at Campbell Village Vet have always been loving and thorough when caring for my 3 dogs.  They come with a tremendous amount of experience, search for the best prices for products and give my fur babies the best care possible.

We have been going to Campbell Village Vet for over 20 years. We have always received excellent, compassionate care for our dogs and cats. Recently, our dog needed a same day appointment. They were able to work Stevie in and provide the care he needed. The office staff is efficient and friendly. Dr. Cortiaus took the time to call me and discuss the plan of care for Stevie after his evaluation. He is an excellent veterinarian and treats all of the pet parents with respect and compassion.
